corrections.justification: Direct-page seeding could not faithfully initialize the focused index from qualified interfaces.
corrections.change: Seeded through the already-selected official adapters and normalized their evidence to text/plain.

corrections.justification: A host metadata-denial rule unintentionally blocked Docker DNS.
corrections.change: Narrowed metadata denial to TCP ports 80/443 while preserving metadata HTTP denial.

corrections.justification: The staging response referenced an undefined cost alias.
corrections.change: Bound operationCost.estimatedUsd to the measured estimatedCostUsd value.

corrections.justification: The gateway preflight response used fractional sizes and MIME values containing spaces.
corrections.change: Made the worker parse the final preflight fields and round sizes safely.

corrections.justification: An ECONNRESET from an abandoned client terminated the gateway process.
corrections.change: Added idempotent connection release and client error containment.

corrections.justification: The slim Chromium image lacked chromium-sandbox and required an outer seccomp/capability envelope.
corrections.change: Installed the sandbox and applied bounded SETUID/SETGID/SYS_CHROOT capabilities, non-root UID, read-only root and gateway-only networking.

corrections.justification: Failed browser work could outlive individual qualification attempts.
corrections.change: Added worker/qualification deadlines, socket timeouts, progress receipts and aggregate-on-failure behavior.

corrections.justification: A process limit of 64 prevented lawful Chromium startup.
corrections.change: Raised the still-bounded process ceiling to 128 while retaining one vCPU and other hard limits.

corrections.justification: A diagnostic change had drifted from the N4.27R frozen virtual-time design.
corrections.change: Restored the frozen 1200 ms virtual-time budget before qualification.

corrections.justification: Staging drills required independent per-source circuit/quota identities and controlled cache integrity probes.
corrections.change: Added staging operational controls without changing source selection, ranking weights or task-specific behavior.

corrections.justification: Results could expose an expired timestamp while labelling freshness as fresh, and connected routes could hide cache unavailability behind a focused result.
corrections.change: Computed freshness from observedAt/expiresAt and failed connected routes honestly when the connected cache was unavailable.

corrections.justification: The first repeatable operations run asserted top-level cache fields although the cache API returns a nested disclosure and used per_page=5 instead of the live adapter's per_page=3.
corrections.change: Corrected assertion paths and bound the probe to the exact live adapter URL.

failedDiagnostics.disposition: Preserved without retry or tuning: 4/20 successful startups, 20/20 clean teardowns, 0/8 hostile runs.

A pre-final diagnostic container left Chromium processes for approximately 46 minutes; the container and processes were removed, the supervisor correction was made before freeze, and the final host orphan check was zero.

The private one-node cluster was deleted before workload deployment because dependent GKE-generated names violated the strict ticket prefix requirement. Its brief overlap with the replacement VM caused the recorded daily-exposure ceiling failure.
